[[bin]]
path = "src/main.rs"
name = "hr-graphql-server"
plugin = false
proc-macro = false
edition = "2021"
required-features = []

[[test]]
path = "tests/contract_tests.rs"
name = "contract_tests"
plugin = false
proc-macro = false
edition = "2021"
required-features = []

[package]
name = "hr-graphql-server"
edition = "2021"
version = "0.0.1"

[dependencies]
anyhow = "1.0"
async-graphql-axum = "7.0"
async-trait = "0.1"
axum = "0.8"
base64 = "0.22"
bcrypt = "0.15"
dataloader = "0.17"
dotenv = "0.15"
envy = "0.4"
futures = "0.3"
http-body-util = "0.1"
jsonwebtoken = "9.0"
rust_decimal = "1.35"
serde_json = "1.0"
thiserror = "1.0"
tracing = "0.1"

[dependencies.async-graphql]
version = "7.0"
features = ["chrono", "uuid", "dataloader", "boxed-trait"]

[dependencies.chrono]
version = "0.4"
features = ["serde"]

[dependencies.sea-orm]
version = "0.12"
features = ["sqlx-postgres", "runtime-tokio-rustls", "macros"]

[dependencies.serde]
version = "1.0"
features = ["derive"]

[dependencies.sqlx]
version = "0.7"
features = ["runtime-tokio-rustls", "postgres", "uuid", "chrono", "migrate", "rust_decimal"]

[dependencies.tokio]
version = "1"
features = ["full"]

[dependencies.tower]
version = "=0.4.13"
features = ["util"]

[dependencies.tower-http]
version = "0.5"
features = ["cors", "trace"]

[dependencies.tracing-subscriber]
version = "0.3"
features = ["env-filter"]

[dependencies.uuid]
version = "1.0"
features = ["serde", "v4"]

[build-dependencies]
sea-orm-codegen = "1.1.17"

[lib]
path = "src/lib.rs"
name = "hr_graphql_server"
plugin = false
proc-macro = false
edition = "2021"
required-features = []
crate-type = ["lib"]

skeleton.config_file:
[target.x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu]
# Use mold linker for significantly faster linking (5-10x speedup)
# Mold is a modern, high-performance linker designed for speed
# Suppress all warnings for cleaner development output
rustflags = [
    "-C", "link-arg=-fuse-ld=mold",
    "-A", "warnings"
]

[build]
# Enable incremental compilation for faster rebuilds
incremental = true
# Cargo will automatically use all available CPU cores for parallel compilation

[alias]
# Convenient cargo commands
check-all = "check --all-targets --all-features"
clippy-all = "clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings"
fmt-check = "fmt -- --check"

[clippy]
# Enforce strict clippy lints
warn-on-all-wildcard-imports = true
skeleton.lock_file:
version = 4
